corrections.issue: Says 'equities held'. Niels said US equities did not lose much in October but other markets did, and calls the equity leg painful for trend followers as well, so equities were a third losing leg.
corrections.fix: October 2024: fixed income peaked at the Fed cut and sold off, US equities lost little but other equity markets fell, and the dollar reversed to strength after being sold, so all three big financial sectors hurt trend followers together.

corrections.issue: Adds 'forward' PE; the transcript says only PE ratios (16 to 22 per the Goldman report) with no forward qualifier.
corrections.fix: PE ratios rose from 16 to 22 over the decade (per the report); a further rise to 28 is unlikely though not impossible, and they need not fall back to 16 but could stay at the current level.
